senses.gloss: (= סחתר, Saf. of חתר; cmp. Arab. šatar) [to dig under,]

units: <cite ref="Megillah 31b:12">Meg. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>אם אמרו לך זקנים סְתוֹר וכ׳</he> if the old tell thee, tear down, and the young, build, tear down and build not, v. <cite ref="O01702"><he>סְתִירָה</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Nedarim 40a">Ned. 40ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הבונה והסוֹתֵר</he> he who builds (on the Sabbath) or who tears down.

<cite ref="Yoma 10a:12">Yoma 10ᵃ</cite> <he>שיפלו בונין ביד סוֹתְרִין</he> that the builders (of the Temple, the Persians) should fall through the hands of the destroyers (the Romans), v. <cite ref="O01691"><he>סָתוֹרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 6:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. VI</cite> <he>סְתָרוֹ ועקרו וכ׳</he> he dug under it (the rock) and broke it loose &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>כותל קשה … וסוֹתְרוֹ</he> a wall is strong, but man has more power and tears it down; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:5">Sot. I, 5</cite> <he>סותר את שערה</he> the priest loosens her hair (<cite ref="Numbers 5:18">Num. V, 18</cite> <he>ופרע</he>); <he>אם … לא היה סוֹתְרוֹ</he> if her hair was beautiful, he did not loosen it. Treat. S’maḥ.ch. ch. VIII <he>סוֹתְרִים שערות וכ׳</he> you may untie the hair of dead brides; a. e.

senses.gloss: to dissolve, decompose. Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥănina 1) (ref. to Prov. XXV, 20) כזה … וסוֹתְרוֹ כך היו סוֹתְרִים וכ׳ as one pours vinegar on natron and decomposes it, so they decomposed (counteracted) the words of the Law; v. infra.

units: Snh. III, 8 כל זמן … סותר את הדין whenever he offers new evidence, he reverses the decision, i.e. the court has to try his case again; לאחר שלשים יום אינו סותר after thirty days, the judgment cannot be disturbed.—Esp. to make void the days of a Nazarite’s vow which have been observed, to begin anew.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 2:10">Naz. II, 10</cite> <he>סותר שבעים</he> he must count seventy days again.

Ib. III, 3 ס׳ את הכל he must count over the whole period (of days); אינו ס׳ אלא שבעה he has to count only seven days over. Tosef. ib. II, 13 יש לו לִסְתּוֹר סותר וכ׳ if there is a portion of the period left to undo, i.e., if the period of his vow has not yet expired, he must count thirty days again; כל … ואין לו לסתור סותר וכ׳ whenever he becomes unclean on a day on which it is improper to offer a sacrifice, and he has nothing left to undo, i.e. his term has expired, and he lacks only a sacrifice to be released: he must count seven days; a. fr.—5 (logics) to contradict, disprove.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26b">Succ. 26ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מעשה לסתור</he>, v. <cite ref="M02186"><he>מַעֲשֶׂה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:8">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>שאלמלא … שהיו דבריו סוֹתְרִין וכ׳</he> but for him, the Book of Ezekiel would have been expunged from the canon, because its words seemed to contradict the words of the Law. Ib. 30ᵃ <he>לא דייך שדבריך סותרין וכ׳</he> not only do thy words contradict those of David, but they contradict one another; a. fr.—
Num. R. s. 13 לא אחד מהן סותר על חבירו neither of them conflicts with the other.—[Yalk. Ex. 356 שלא יסתרו, v. סָרַס I Hithpa.]

senses.gloss: to be disarranged, be undone. Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ; Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14ᵃ מִיסְתַּתֵּר הוא the web will go apart again, opp. מתקיים.
